quantize_per_tensor: quantize a float32 tensor to a lower precision dtype using per-tensor affine quantization parameters
quantize_per_channel: quantize a float32 tensor to a lower precision dtype using per-channel affine quantization along a specified axis
dequantize_per_tensor: dequantize a quantized tensor back to float32 using per-tensor scale and zero-point parameters
dequantize_per_channel: dequantize a quantized tensor back to float32 using per-channel scale and zero-point parameters along a specified axis
choose_qparams_tensor: derive per-tensor affine quantization scale and zero-point parameters from a float32 input tensor
